rows.commentary: 0.3: Abbas drifts onto the pads, and Lahiru Udara nudges it past mid-on to collect the opening run.
0.4: Abbas finds sharp inward movement at 120.8kph to trap Pasindu Sooriyabandara high on the front pad, comfortably missing the stumps.
0.5: Abbas pitches fuller, drawing a slight shuffle from Sooriyabandara who blocks with an angled bat.
0.6: Abbas attacks off stump at 121.3kph, met by a disciplined forward defense from Sooriyabandara.
1.1: Saqib Khan floats a gentle away-swinger that Udara maneuvers into the off side for a single.
1.2: Saqib Khan oversteps as a 127.8kph outswinger straightens past Sooriyabandara's dangling bat.
1.2: Saqib Khan pushes it through at 129kph, allowing Sooriyabandara to push toward mid-on and get off the mark.
1.3: Saqib Khan delivers a 128.9kph fullish ball that Udara glances toward forward square leg.
1.4: Saqib Khan digs it fuller at 128.5kph, and Udara covers the line to turn it away safely.
1.5: Saqib Khan hits the 131.1kph mark, inducing a soft-handed block from Udara that trickles to gully.
1.6: Saqib Khan targets a 128.9kph full length, smoothly patted away toward the cover region.
2.1: Abbas drops short of a good length, steering an easy push from Sooriyabandara straight to backward point.
2.2: Abbas finds that lethal channel, landing it full of a good length to draw Pasindu Sooriyabandara into a drive before sharply jagging it away past the outside edge.
2.3: Abbas delivers at 122.3kph on a length outside off, leaving Sooriyabandara entirely squared up as he tries to defend.
2.4: Abbas strays down the leg side at 123kph, requiring the wicketkeeper to dive smartly to his left and mop it up.
2.5: Abbas pushes the speed up to 123.4kph, angling one in from a fuller length that prompts Sooriyabandara to step across and dead-bat it toward short leg.
2.6: Abbas clocks 121.4kph as Sooriyabandara steps out once more, inside-edging his defensive prod down to deep fine leg for a single.

12.1: Abbas angles one in from round the wicket at one hundred twenty-one point eight kilometers per hour, catching Kamindu Mendis on the thigh as the ball drops safely short of the diving short leg fielder.
12.2: Abbas strikes as Kamindu Mendis plays too early on a slower length delivery, chipping it neatly to short cover where Tayyab Arif dives brilliantly to snaffle the catch.
12.3: Abbas delivers on a length well wide of off stump, allowing Dhananjaya to watch it through and leave it alone.
12.4: Abbas gets this length delivery to shape away slightly, prompting a back foot defensive push from Dhananjaya.
12.5: Abbas attacks the stumps with a fairly full delivery at one hundred twenty point eight kilometers per hour, which Dhananjaya moves back and across to defend toward short mid-on.
12.6: Abbas fires it in from wide of the crease with the angle, and Dhananjaya comfortably shoulders arms.
13.1: Razaullah clocks one hundred forty-four point seven kilometers per hour, sending down a full swinging delivery outside off that draws a loose drive from Lahiru Udara and beats the outside edge.

13.2: Razaullah finds the breakthrough with a fierce delivery that rears off a good length at one hundred forty-six point six kilometers per hour, forcing an edge from Lahiru Udara that Mohammad Taha safely pouches above his right shoulder at first slip.
13.3: Razaullah targets the stumps with a fullish delivery, which Kusal Mendis solidly defends toward the cover region.

13.4: Razaullah extracts extra bounce from a length at one hundred forty-six point nine kilometers per hour, taking the shoulder of Kusal Mendis's bat and looping safely into the gap between gully and backward point for a couple of runs.
13.5: Razaullah runs in with three slips and two gullies in place, testing Kusal Mendis with a sharp delivery from short of a length that the batter hops back to defend.

13.6: Razaullah caps off a blistering over at one hundred forty-five point eight kilometers per hour, sliding a full delivery across Kusal Mendis who flashes hard in search of a drive and gets thoroughly beaten by the late away-curv.
14.1: Abbas targets the full outside-off channel, drawing Dhananjaya half-forward to dead-bat it into the turf.
14.2: Abbas dials it up to 121.6kph, luring Dhananjaya into shouldering arms as the ball snakes away past off-stump.
14.3: Abbas arrows one down leg at 123.6kph, clipping the shuffling batsman's pad on its way to the diving keeper's gloves.
22.4: Saqib Khan overpitches wide of off, allowing Sonal Dinusha to lean across and pierce the gap past cover with an angled bat.
22.5: Saqib Khan lands this on a good length outside off, prompting Sonal Dinusha to drop firmly behind the line in defense.
22.6: Saqib Khan pushes a fuller delivery wider across off stump, and Sonal Dinusha comfortably watches it pass.
23.1: Aamer Jamal attacks just outside off on a nagging length, forcing Kusal Mendis to slide behind the line and block to the off-side.
23.2: Aamer Jamal finds a sound length on off stump, allowing Kusal Mendis to softly guide the ball down toward gully.
23.3: Aamer Jamal sends down a sharp shooter that nips back to strike Kusal Mendis on the back thigh, drawing a brief, unsuccessful appeal.
23.4: Aamer Jamal offers width with a short delivery, and Kusal Mendis pounces by cracking it behind square on the off-side for four.
23.5: Aamer Jamal digs it in short at the right-hander, and Kusal Mendis swivels to pull it behind square on the on-side for a single.
23.6: Aamer Jamal extracts extra bounce from a short of a good length, prompting Sonal Dinusha to play inside the line and let it go.
24.1: Abbas floats one outside off, drawing Kusal Mendis forward into a drive that misses the outside edge.
24.2: Abbas raps Kusal Mendis on the pads with a delivery leaving the batter, but Pakistan's review fails as the ball bounces over the stumps.
24.3: Abbas probes the channel on a good length outside off, leaving Kusal Mendis undisturbed as he offers no stroke.
24.4: Abbas nails a probing good-length delivery outside off, and Kusal Mendis strides forward to dead-bat it straight back to the bowler.
24.5: Abbas drifts down the leg side with a fuller offering, eluding Mendis's flick before Ghazi Ghori scrambles to get a glove on it.
24.6: Abbas probes the corridor on a good length as Mendis pulls his bat away at the very last moment, watching the ball carom off Ghazi Ghori's forearm and drop safely in front of the slip cordon.
25.1: Aamer Jamal attacks the good-length zone outside off, prompting Sonal Dinusha to lean well forward into a solid defensive stroke.
25.2: Aamer Jamal persists on a good length outside off, letting the ball hold its line while Dinusha watches it sail past untouched.
25.3: No run for Sonal Dinusha off Aamer Jamal.
26.2: Abbas drops it on a good length outside off, and Mendis opens his stance to steer it smoothly into the off-side.
26.3: Abbas hits a tight channel just short of a length, tempting the right-hander who wisely lets it pass.
26.4: Mendis dances down the track to a fuller ball on the pads, chipping it uppishly past short leg to comfortably hustle back for three runs.
26.5: Abbas comes round the wicket, angling it into Dinusha before getting it to nip away and narrowly beat the outside edge.
26.6: Abbas maintains a probing good length outside off, shaping away as Dinusha makes a disciplined leave.
27.1: Jamal unleashes a searing inswinging yorker that forces a shuffling Mendis to jam his bat down just in time.
27.2: Jamal delivers on a good length outside off, defended solidly toward the off-side.
27.3: Jamal extracts extra bounce from a back of a length delivery, catching Mendis's top-edge on a pull shot for Saqib Khan to pouch safely in the deep.
27.4: Jamal targets the left-hander on a good length, angling back in for Rathnayake to push straight back to the bowler.
27.5: Jamal serves a fuller delivery shaping away wide of off, drawing Rathnayake into a drive that sails past the outside edge.
27.6: Jamal bangs it in short of a good length, zipping over Rathnayake's hopeful waft as it holds its line.
28.1: Abbas finds a disciplined good length just outside off, prompting Dinusha onto the front foot for a solid defensive push.
28.2: Abbas drops it on a good length wide of off, making the ball hiss away as Sonal Dinusha watches it sail through to the keeper.
28.3: Abbas hits the corridor outside off and extracts an edge from Sonal Dinusha, but the batsman cushions his hands expertly as the ball dies on the turf before first slip.
28.4: Abbas floats a fuller delivery in the channel, but Sonal Dinusha stays disciplined and offers no stroke.
28.5: Abbas pitches it slightly fuller just outside off, prompting Sonal Dinusha to march down the track and dead-bat it into the off-side.
28.6: Abbas maintains a tight good length angling across the left-hander, leaving Sonal Dinusha to comfortably shoulder arms to end the over.
0.1: Asitha Fernando starts with a shortish delivery outside off that drifts away, allowing Azan Awais to steer it firmly toward backward point.
0.2: Fernando keeps it fractionally short outside off, prompting Azan Awais to play from the crease and knock it into the off-side.
0.3: Fernando lands it on a length around middle and leg with a hint of inward movement, and Azan Awais manages an inside edge onto the on-side for a single.
0.4: Fernando digs it in short around middle and leg, surprising Tayyab Arif with extra bounce so that it takes the splice and drops softly near the pitch.
0.5: Fernando hits a much better length outside off with subtle away seam, beating Tayyab Arif entirely on his forward defensive push.
0.6: Fernando maintains a sensible length around off, and Tayyab Arif safely defends it down into the off-side.
1.1: Milan Rathnayake digs in back of a length outside off and extracts away-movement to zip past Azan Awais's outside edge.
1.2: Rathnayake operates slightly short around off, permitting Azan Awais to dead-bat his defense into the off-side.
1.3: Rathnayake hits the corridor outside off with sharp seam away, leaving Azan Awais grasping at thin air in a testing spell for the openers.
1.4: Rathnayake pulls back his length fractionally, inviting Azan Awais to have a look before making a very late decision to leave it alone.
1.5: Rathnayake comes around the wicket on a length, and Azan Awais covers the line adeptly to steer the ball into the off-side.
1.6: Rathnayake bangs it in short from round the wicket, thudding into Azan Awais's thigh pad while the bowler fruitlessly appeals.
2.1: Asitha Fernando drifts this full delivery right around the off-stump channel, neatly intercepted by Tayyab Arif with a solid push into the extra cover region.
2.2: Asitha Fernando drops it back around middle and leg, where Tayyab Arif pounces on the low bounce to whip it away into the mid-wicket pocket for four.
2.3: Asitha Fernando angles a sharp, short delivery into middle and leg, allowing Tayyab Arif to nudge it comfortably into the leg-side for a single.
2.4: Asitha Fernando drops short and Azan Awais seizes the width, carving it behind gully with supreme timing for four.
12.6: Lahiru Kumara offers width outside off and Azan Awais unleashes a pristine square drive flashing through point for four.
13.1: Milan Rathnayake finds the inside edge of Tayyab Arif's bat, scuttling the ball harmlessly toward the leg side.
13.2: Milan Rathnayake hits a back of a length around off stump, patted securely toward cover by Tayyab Arif.
13.3: Milan Rathnayake pitches this delivery full around off, smoothly driven straight to mid-off by Tayyab Arif.
13.4: Milan Rathnayake targets middle and leg, tickled away toward wide mid-on for a single by Tayyab Arif.
13.5: Milan Rathnayake angles one away outside off, leaving Azan Awais to watch it pass into the gloves.
13.6: Milan Rathnayake serves width outside off, ignored completely as Azan Awais offers no stroke.
14.1: Asitha Fernando drifts it outside off, steered through backward point for a couple as Pakistan cross fifty.
14.2: Asitha Fernando drops it on a length, firmly pushed toward mid-off by Tayyab Arif.
14.3: Asitha Fernando serves it full outside off, guided through the off-side for a single by Tayyab Arif.
14.4: Asitha Fernando hits the surface outside off, dabbed away through the off-side for a brisk single by Azan Awais.
14.5: Asitha Fernando floats a half-volley around off, exquisitely driven through cover for four by Tayyab Arif.
14.6: Asitha Fernando fires it in on a length, Tayyab Arif nudges it toward mid-on where a sloppy fumble allows them to cross for a single.
15.1: Milan Rathnayake serves up a fuller delivery outside off, Tayyab Arif angling the face to guide it straight toward backward point.
15.2: Milan Rathnayake tests the length again, sliced toward backward point where the fielder produces a stunning dive to his left to cut it off.
15.3: Milan Rathnayake lands this on a good length around middle and leg, pushed firmly into the mid-on region by Tayyab Arif for a dot.
15.4: Milan Rathnayake angles one on a good length outside off, drawing a tentative poke from Tayyab Arif that easily beats the outside edge.
15.5: Milan Rathnayake drops it in short of a good length, Tayyab Arif getting inside the line to knock it firmly in front of the cover fielder.
15.6: Dot ball from Milan Rathnayake to Tayyab Arif.
22.5: Prabath Jayasuriya flights a very full delivery at 89.9kph that Azan Awais flicks directly to midwicket.
22.6: Prabath Jayasuriya drops it short outside off, allowing Azan Awais to punch off the back foot straight to backward point.
23.1: Asitha Fernando hurls it full, tempting Tayyab Arif into a drive as the ball moves away past the edge.
23.2: Asitha Fernando charges in at 131.9kph, shortening his stride only to watch the delivery drift harmlessly down the leg side past Tayyab Arif.
23.3: Asitha Fernando angles a length delivery in, and Tayyab Arif quietly tucks it toward midwicket.
23.4: Asitha Fernando digs it in short, catching the inside edge of Tayyab Arif's bat onto his thigh pad as it drops to square leg.
23.5: Asitha Fernando strikes as Tayyab Arif reaches away from his body, feathering an edge through to Kusal Mendis behind the stumps.
23.6: Asitha Fernando clocks one in at 135.3kph, digging it short of length as Mohammad Taha drops his wrists and dead-bats the delivery with a closed face.
24.1: Prabath Jayasuriya tosses it full on leg, and Azan Awais clips it neatly into the midwicket region.
24.2: Prabath Jayasuriya flights a full delivery, met by a forward defensive prod from Azan Awais.
24.3: Prabath Jayasuriya serves up another defensive block, safely negotiated on the front foot by Azan Awais.
24.4: Prabath Jayasuriya keeps it fractionally short, permitting Azan Awais to drop back and defend cleanly.
24.5: Prabath Jayasuriya maintains a straight length with no turn, knocked down solidly toward short mid-on by Azan Awais.

24.6: Prabath Jayasuriya flights this fuller delivery at eighty-seven point six kilometers per hour, finding Azan Awais who pushes it sharply towards short mid-on before a brilliant diving stop denies the single.
25.1: Asitha Fernando charges in at 135.4kph, dropping it on a good length outside off stump as Mohammad Taha watches it sail through.
25.2: Asitha Fernando attacks the channel outside off at 134.7kph, forcing Mohammad Taha to gently tap it into the off-side.
25.3: Asitha Fernando fizzes a 131.2kph delivery full and nipping away, beating the defensive push of Mohammad Taha comfortably outside the edge.
25.4: Asitha Fernando pitches it up at 133.8kph, inviting Mohammad Taha into a crisp drive straight to the fielder at mid-on.
34.5: Prabath Jayasuriya angles one in at Babar Azam, who tries to work it away only to catch an inside edge straight into his pads.
34.6: Babar Azam dances down the track to meet Prabath Jayasuriya, drills the ball past the bowler, clips the non-striker's stumps, and sends it racing to the boundary.
35.1: Lahiru Kumara drifts a short delivery down the leg-side, catching the thigh pad of Azan Awais on its way to the fine leg ropes for four leg byes.
35.2: Lahiru Kumara delivers on a length outside off, and Azan Awais guides it gently into the off-side to rotate the strike with a single.
35.3: Lahiru Kumara strikes as Babar Azam offers a fatal leave to a length ball that nips back sharply and smashes into the top of off stump.
35.4: Lahiru Kumara bangs in a sharp, quick delivery outside off with extra carry as Saqib Khan watches it sail past.
35.5: Lahiru Kumara targets the channel outside off, shaping sharply back in as Saqib Khan lets it pass safely.
35.6: Lahiru Kumara digs a short one down the leg-side, forcing Saqib Khan to duck as the keeper leaps across to gather it cleanly.
36.1: Prabath Jayasuriya tosses one up fractionally short outside off, allowing Azan Awais to punch it into the off-side for a single.
36.2: Prabath Jayasuriya flights it around off, and Saqib Khan firmly knocks the ball right back down the pitch.
36.3: Prabath Jayasuriya floats it up, and Saqib Khan meets it with soft hands to steer the ball into the off-side.
36.4: Prabath Jayasuriya fires it flatter through the air on middle and leg, safely patted back down the pitch by Saqib Khan.
36.5: Prabath Jayasuriya angles it into Saqib Khan, who gets an inside edge onto his pad as the ball trickles toward short leg.
36.6: Prabath Jayasuriya offers flight, and Saqib Khan dances down the track, miscues an agricultural heave over extra cover, and scurries back for two unorthodox runs.
37.1: Lahiru Kumara pins Azan Awais on the pads with a sharp length delivery, though the height appeal is rightly dismissed.
37.2: Lahiru Kumara digs it in short to Azan Awais, who fends it away before fading light forces the umpires to call Stumps on Day 1.
37.4: Kumara drops it on a lively short of a good length outside off, and Awais safely gets right behind the line to dead-bat it into the on-side.
37.5: Kumara searches for a fraction more fullness just outside off, prompting Awais to prod across the crease and smother it safely on the off-side.
37.6: Kumara dangles the perfect sucker ball pitching up and holding its line wide of off, completely seducing Awais into a drive that whistles past the outside edge.
38.1: Rathnayake finds a good length with a hint of outward swing from wide of off, allowing Saqib to play inside the line and comfortably let it pass.
38.2: Rathnayake offers a fuller length delivery shaping invitingly away from wide of off, which is watched closely all the way and left alone.
38.3: Rathnayake pulls his length back to just short of good as the ball shapes away from wide of off, drawing another easy leave from Saqib.
38.4: Rathnayake smartly shortens his length and holds his line outside off, leaving Saqib with a simple decision to shoulder arms.
38.5: Rathnayake pitches one up and nips it viciously back into the right-hander, beating Saqib's forward push on the outside edge as he plays down the wrong line.

38.6: Rathnayake traps Saqib deep in the crease with a sharp nip-backer striking the front pad in front of middle and leg, though the swing ensures it drifts harmlessly down leg despite a booming appeal.
39.1: Kumara bangs it in short and makes it climb menacingly at the left-hander, forcing Awais to hop across, drop his wrists, and gracefully sway away from the line.
39.2: Kumara targets a fuller length outside off, inviting Awais to lean forward into a crisp defensive stroke directed straight toward mid-off.
39.3: Kumara targets the batter with a fierce short delivery, forcing a blind, clumsy fend from Awais that strikes his gloves and fortuitously drops straight down to safety.
39.4: Kumara extracts the edge with a probing channel delivery that draws Awais forward into a fatal defensive prod, safely snaffled by Mendis to end a 47-run knock.
39.5: Kumara greets Shakeel with a sharp, angled short ball down leg, allowing the new batsman to drop his hands and evade the line comfortably.
39.6: Kumara completes a wicket-maiden as Shakeel rocks back on a three-quarter length ball outside off and guides it straight to the gully fielder.
48.6: Prabath Jayasuriya flights one enticingly outside off, drawing Saqib Khan forward into a watchful defensive lunge.
49.1: Asitha Fernando targets a tight channel, nipping the ball back to cramp Saud Shakeel into an under-edged squeeze on the off-side.
49.2: Asitha Fernando attacks the stumps with a probing length, sliding past Saud Shakeel's inside edge as he attempts a tuck.
49.3: Asitha Fernando serves up a fuller delivery outside off, and Saud Shakeel adopts an open stance to dead-bat it into the off-side.
49.4: Asitha Fernando errs down the leg side, forcing Kusal Mendis into a full-length athletic dive to gather the ball.
49.5: Asitha Fernando digs one in short of a good length, allowing Saud Shakeel to nudge it into the gap wide of mid-wicket for a comfortable brace.
49.6: Asitha Fernando bowls a fuller length on off, met by a lean across and a straight punch back at the bowler by Saud Shakeel.
50.1: Prabath Jayasuriya tosses it up on off, inviting Saqib Khan to push it straight towards the mid-off fielder.
50.2: Prabath Jayasuriya drops it on middle with flight, prompting Saqib Khan to rock back and stab it back down the pitch.
50.3: Prabath Jayasuriya gives the ball nice loop on off, and Saqib Khan answers with a textbook forward defensive block.
50.4: Prabath Jayasuriya fires in a slick slider that drifts inward, catching the inside edge of Saqib Khan's bat as he pushes ahead.
50.5: Prabath Jayasuriya lobs one just outside off, where a half-forward Saqib Khan calmly jabs it away into the off-side.
50.6: Prabath Jayasuriya drops it fractionally short at the stumps, allowing Saqib Khan to tuck it behind square on the on-side for a single.
51.1: Asitha Fernando digs it in short, watching the ball sail harmlessly over the head of Saqib Khan.
51.2: Asitha Fernando follows up with another bouncer that stays lower, forcing Saqib Khan to bend down deeply to evade it.
51.3: Asitha Fernando attacks from back of a length at the stumps, prompting Saqib Khan to back away and miscue a pull through mid-wicket for a single.
51.4: Asitha Fernando targets the pads with a length delivery clipped past square leg for one, before an errant shy at the bowler's end lacks backup and races away to gift five runs.
51.5: Asitha Fernando bangs another short delivery right into the stumps as Saqib Khan comfortably ducks underneath it.
51.6: Asitha Fernando pitches it fuller and shapes it away outside off, drawing a meek poke from Saqib Khan that whistles past the outside edge.
62.2: Prabath Jayasuriya angles a length delivery in, and Ghazi Ghori steps back to push it toward the on-side.
62.3: Prabath Jayasuriya tosses it up full on the stumps, safely met by Ghazi Ghori back toward the bowler.
62.4: Prabath Jayasuriya spears this full delivery into the pads, allowing Ghazi Ghori to sweep powerfully down to deep backward square leg for a couple.
62.5: Prabath Jayasuriya tests the off-stump channel with flight, and Ghazi Ghori solidly shuts it down from the front foot.
62.6: Prabath Jayasuriya drops it full outside off at 85.4kph, and Ghazi Ghori crouches to fiercely sweep it away to the boundary, pushing Pakistan's lead past 100.
63.1: Lahiru Kumara directs a length ball into middle and leg, comfortably blocked out by Salman Agha.
63.2: Lahiru Kumara offers width on a full delivery, inviting Salman Agha to lean across and pierce extra cover with a crisp drive.
63.3: Lahiru Kumara drops a length ball in, and Salman Agha taps it toward cover to scamper through for a single.
63.4: Lahiru Kumara gets a short-of-length delivery to wiz past outside off as Ghazi Ghori flails and misses entirely.
63.5: Lahiru Kumara charges in at 129.8kph with a shortish ball that Ghazi Ghori masterfully rides to punch toward backward point.
63.6: Lahiru Kumara floats it full and wide outside the off stump, inviting Ghazi Ghori to play, but the batter wisely leaves it alone to sail through to the keeper.
64.1: Prabath Jayasuriya drifts one toward leg stump, and Salman Agha gets forward to defend on the pitch.

64.2: Prabath Jayasuriya offers a generous, floated invitation that Salman Agha eagerly accepts, punching through extra cover before Lahiru Udara hurls his body across the turf in a desperate tumbling rescue.
64.3: Salman Agha skips down the pitch, pushes Prabath Jayasuriya firmly toward mid-off, and scampers across safely despite a desperate direct-hit at the bowler's end.
64.4: Prabath Jayasuriya drifts one in toward middle stump, and Ghazi Ghori quietly tucks it away into the leg-side.
64.5: Ghazi Ghori strides forward to meet Prabath Jayasuriya's delivery, dead-batting it solidly from the crease.
64.6: Meeting a full delivery from Prabath Jayasuriya on the front foot, Ghazi Ghori can only drill it straight to short cover.
65.1: Asitha Fernando digs it in back of a length, prompting Salman Agha to rise on his toes and absorb the defensive blow.
65.2: Asitha Fernando targets the channel outside off, and Salman Agha cleverly angles the face at the very last moment to steer it past the slips for four.
66.3: Milan Rathnayake tests the stumps with a tight length, and Ghazi Ghori strides forward to punch it straight to short cover.
66.4: Operating at 124.8kph, Milan Rathnayake delivers full to Ghazi Ghori, who shuffles across to clip it sharply toward the right of mid-on.
66.5: Milan Rathnayake overcorrects with a delivery that is too full and wide, allowing Salman Agha to carve a smooth drive through the cover region for three runs.
66.6: Milan Rathnayake drops back to a testing length, and Ghazi Ghori gets behind the line to dead-bat it into the off-side.
67.1: Asitha Fernando lands one on a length that viciously jags back in to trap Salman Agha plumb in front, and ball-tracking confirms three reds to seal the breakthrough.
67.2: Asitha Fernando searches for swing with a full delivery angled into the pads, easily worked away by Aamer Jamal toward fine leg.
67.3: Asitha Fernando serves it full, and Ghazi Ghori simply pushes the delivery straight to the fielder stationed at mid-on.
67.4: Asitha Fernando targets the leg stump with a probing length, and Ghazi Ghori calmly tucks it into the midwicket pocket.
67.5: Clocked at 131kph, Asitha Fernando strays too straight on the pads, enabling Ghazi Ghori to easily help it on its way toward long leg.
67.6: Asitha Fernando pitches this one right up to the batter, inviting Aamer Jamal to drive firmly straight to the fielder at mid-off.
68.1: Charging in at 126.2kph, Milan Rathnayake tests Ghazi Ghori with a sharp delivery from short of a length that gets pushed softly back down the pitch.
68.2: Milan Rathnayake extracts extra bounce outside off, catching the outside half of Ghazi Ghori's bat as gully flies to his right with a brilliant diving stop.
68.3: Milan Rathnayake digs this one into the surface at 129.3kph, and Ghazi Ghori stays back to dead-bat it right back down the pitch.
68.4: Milan Rathnayake offers a fullish length, met securely by Ghazi Ghori as he pushes it firmly toward the bowler.
68.5: Milan Rathnayake tests the batsman with a skiddy 125.8kph delivery that keeps low, forcing an outer edge from Ghazi Ghori onto the off-side.
68.6: Milan Rathnayake spears it full and wide outside off, leaving Ghazi Ghori unbothered as he lets it pass to signal Lunch on Day 2.
78.2: Prabath Jayasuriya flights one up on off stump, allowing Razaullah to stroke it down to long-on for a comfortable single.
78.3: Prabath Jayasuriya drops it full and straight into the stumps, and Ghazi Ghori pushes it firmly down to long-on to rotate the strike.
78.4: Prabath Jayasuriya tosses it up and follows Razaullah as the batter creates room, safely defended straight back to the bowler.
78.5: Prabath Jayasuriya flights the ball on off stump, and Razaullah gets well forward to dead-bat it into the pitch.
78.6: Prabath Jayasuriya drops slightly short outside off with the quicker delivery, punched off the back foot straight to cover.
79.1: Asitha Fernando lands it on a good length on off stump, solidly defended back down the pitch by Ghazi Ghori.
79.2: Asitha Fernando digs it in short at the stumps, forcing Ghazi Ghori to duck underneath and let it pass through.
79.3: Asitha Fernando attacks the body with a short delivery, grazing Ghazi Ghori's thigh pad after a missed pull to roll onto the on-side for a leg bye.
79.4: Asitha Fernando delivers back of a length at the stumps, and Razaullah clears room to hammer a pullevents over mid-wicket for a resounding boundary.
79.5: Asitha Fernando offers a low full toss outside off, neatly carved away square on the off side for a single.
